entities.summary: Anthony Edward Aaron Aedy is an English guitarist who is best known as the rhythm guitarist of the gothic metal band Paradise Lost. He founded the band in 1988 alongside Stephen Edmondson, Gregor Mackintosh and Nick Holmes. Outside from playing the rhythm guitar, sometimes he plays acoustic guitar on some albums such as Shades of God and Draconian Times.
